newsitem.title: UK: Reuters buys healthcare services business.
newsitem.headline: Reuters buys healthcare services business.

text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc said it had bought The Micro Solutions Group Plc, a supplier of computer-based healthcare services, for an undisclosed amount.
Reuters said the amount, which was "not material in the context of Reuters net assets," was paid in cash and loan notes.

The Micro Solutions Group, based in Surrey, southern England, provides practice management systems serving clinical and administrative needs to over 3,000 general practitioners, Reuters said in a statement.
Geoffrey Sanderson, managing director of Value Added Medical Products (VAMP), a wholly owned Reuters subsidiary, becomes chairman of Micro Solutions.

"Micro Solutions has an excellent product range, which complements our existing products, innovative staff and a loyal customer base. Each of these will benefit from Reuters investment, resources and information skills," Sanderson said.

Jane Wightman, newly appointed managing director of Micro Solutions, said the change in ownership "presents exciting opportunities to provide our customers with new products and services of the highest calibre."
